description.value: A motel in Fort St. James, BC, offering rooms with kitchenettes, microwaves, and fridges, positioned within walking distance of Fort St. James National Historic Park and Stuart Lake. The front desk is staffed around the clock, and the property accepts debit and major credit cards. The reservations page notes the property is now operating as 'The View Hotel,' suggesting a recent rebrand.
